`Reminder: If you know which team will be responsible for this issue, add the label for that team.`

**Type**: Meeting Notes / ADR / Branding / Style Guide / Source Code / General
**Description:** What documentation needs to be made or updated? What is the new document about OR what changes are being made to the document? Include relevant material like links to Canvas assignment writeups, existing issues, meeting dates where it was discussed, etc. Detailed is good, but keep straightforward.

**Subtasks:** List of relevant subtasks (as issue numbers)
- [ ] #x
- [ ] #y

**Status:** Does it pass our definition of done?
`Mark passed whatever is not applicable`
- [ ] Pass HTML and CSS validators
- [ ] Pass end-to-end automation
- [ ] Follow the style guides
- [ ] Reviewed by group
- [ ] Checked off by DevOps
- [ ] Specifications are met (*expand on this list per issue*)
  - [ ] Specification 1
